name: sdlc
description: Repo-level enforcement kits for the agentic SDLC, plus the machine-wide credential guard. credential-guard is a PreToolUse hook on Bash that blocks staging or committing credential-shaped files, active wherever the plugin is installed (it moved here from pm in 0.2.0). gate-hooks installs one gate script into a repo's .claude/ (production gate, protected paths, a test lock for fix tasks, a commit and Stop backstop), driven by .claude/sdlc/gates.json. review-policy sets up REVIEW.md and runs a read-only, fresh-context policy reviewer against it. Uses only Claude Code features: no pm, Ringer or Codex dependency.
